title: Suffering Is The Medicine, And Pleasure
summary: Anxiety is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Suffering is the medicine, and pleasure the disease, because where there is pleasure, there is no desire for God
lifeApplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
